"""CLI pre-execution judge client selection (job-hunter-akxe)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable, Coroutine
from typing import cast
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from src.cli.run import agent
from src.types.typed import JsonObject

pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit

_build_llm_client = cast("Callable[[], object | None]", agent._build_llm_client)
_run_pre_execution_judge = cast(
    "Callable[[JsonObject, JsonObject], Coroutine[object, object, dict[str, object]]]",
    agent._run_pre_execution_judge,
)

_SKIP_LOG = "LLM_USE_REAL_API disabled; skipping pre-execution judge"
_JUDGE_MODEL = object()
_DEFAULT_MODEL = object()
_AGENT_LOGGER = "src.cli.run.agent"


def test_build_llm_client_skips_when_real_api_disabled(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv("LLM_USE_REAL_API", "0")
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.llm.get_llm_client", lambda: _DEFAULT_MODEL)
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.llm.get_judge_model", lambda: _JUDGE_MODEL)

    result = _build_llm_client()

    assert result is None, (
        "offline CLI runs must not build a FakeStructuredChatModel judge client"
    )


def test_build_llm_client_uses_judge_model_when_real_api_enabled(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv("LLM_USE_REAL_API", "1")
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.llm.use_real_api", lambda: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.llm.get_judge_model", lambda: _JUDGE_MODEL)
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.llm.get_llm_client", lambda: _DEFAULT_MODEL)

    result = _build_llm_client()

    assert result is _JUDGE_MODEL, (
        "online CLI judge path must honor get_judge_model / LLM_JUDGE_MODEL, "
        "not the default get_llm_client model"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_run_pre_execution_judge_skips_offline_without_building_graph(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv("LLM_USE_REAL_API", "0")
    build_judge = Mock()
    monkeypatch.setattr(agent, "build_judge", build_judge)

    with caplog.at_level("INFO", logger=_AGENT_LOGGER):
        verdicts = await _run_pre_execution_judge({"actions": []}, {})

    assert verdicts == {}, (
        "offline pre-execution judging must return empty verdicts, not mock verdicts"
    )
    assert build_judge.call_count == 0, (
        f"offline CLI must skip the judge subgraph, calls={build_judge.call_count}"
    )
    assert _SKIP_LOG in caplog.text, (
        f"offline skip must log {_SKIP_LOG!r}, got {caplog.text!r}"
    )
